news.title: Hassett says the economy is ‘best we’ve ever seen’
news.summary: Kevin Hassett, the director of the National Economic Council (NEC), on Sunday said the economy is the “best we’ve ever seen” as the Trump administration and Republicans make their final pitches heading into the midterm elections. “So the great big picture about the economy is that it’s about the best economy we’ve ever seen,” Hassett…
